proof_body:
by
  intro X _ S x hS hx
  have hT : TotallyBounded ((fun y : X => (y : UniformSpace.Completion X)) '' S) :=
    hS.image (UniformSpace.Completion.uniformContinuous_coe X)
  have hK : IsCompact (closure ((fun y : X => (y : UniformSpace.Completion X)) '' S)) :=
    hT.closure.isCompact_of_isClosed isClosed_closure
  obtain ⟨a, _, p, hp, h⟩ := hK.tendsto_subseq (x := fun n => ((x n : X) : UniformSpace.Completion X))
    (fun n => subset_closure ⟨x n, hx n, rfl⟩)
  refine ⟨p, hp, ?_⟩
  have hc := h.cauchySeq
  rw [Metric.cauchySeq_iff] at hc ⊢
  intro ε hε
  obtain ⟨K, hK'⟩ := hc ε hε
  refine ⟨K, fun m hm n hn => ?_⟩
  have h1 := hK' m hm n hn
  simpa [UniformSpace.Completion.dist_eq] using h1
target_source: ∀ (X : Type*) [MetricSpace X] (S : Set X) (x : ℕ → X), TotallyBounded S → (∀ n, x n ∈ S) → ∃ p : ℕ → ℕ, StrictMono p ∧ CauchySeq (fun n => x (p n))
